_comment: Databricks Jobs API definition for the config-driven ingestion pipeline.
Or via the Databricks UI: Workflows → Create Job → Import JSON.
BEFORE IMPORTING — update the following placeholders:
run_source_ingestion — single task. Loads all active tasks for the source,
then for each table (threaded, max_workers): runs a lightweight presence
check immediately followed by extraction for that same table. Tables with
0 rows in the source get a SKIPPED audit row and extraction is skipped —
lookup and extraction are no longer separate job tasks.
name: generic_source_to_bronze_ingestion

parameters.name: config_master_id
parameters.description: Config Master ID pointing to the child config table (e.g. 13 for NoSQL, 2 for RDBMS).

parameters.name: source_system_id
parameters.description: Source System PK (integer) from config_source_system table.

parameters.name: pipeline_name
parameters.description: Pipeline name — used to filter active tasks in the child config table (e.g. rdbms_ingestion_config.Pipeline_Name).

parameters.name: job_run_id
parameters.description: Databricks job run ID — auto-populated from job context.

parameters.name: landing_volume_path
parameters.description: Base S3/Volume path for raw landing (e.g. s3://pfl-raw/landing). Leave blank to skip.

parameters.name: max_workers
parameters.description: Max parallel workers — each worker runs a presence check then extraction for one table.

_comment: For each active table: runs the presence check then, if data exists,
